title: Name availability re-check after scope broadening (rename)
context: Project owner broadened the scope from TDLAS-only to all sensing modalities where physically rigorous synthetic ML training data can be generated. The original name OpenGasSpec no longer fits; G1 re-run for replacement candidates.
previous_name: OpenGasSpec (G1 pass archived in g1_report.json; superseded)

opensensesim.note: available but confusable with OpenSense (SimTK IMU-sensing tool in the OpenSim ecosystem)

synthsense.note: github user taken; SynSense neuromorphic company adjacent

general_search_confusion.result: No project of this name exists. Nearby names reviewed: OpenSense (SimTK, IMU biomechanics — distinct full name and domain), OpenSensors.io (IoT data platform — distinct suffix and domain), OpenSim (biomechanics). No active same-name software project.

decision: PASS — 'OpenSensorSim' (package 'opensensorsim') selected. All repository text renamed; historical gate reports under gates/reports/ retained verbatim under the old name as archival evidence.
human_action_required: Register GitHub org/repo, PyPI package, HF org under 'opensensorsim'. GitHub account 'spectramaster' is authenticated on this machine (gh CLI, repo+workflow scopes); Hugging Face has no token configured yet.
